title: G's Dash
description: Driver display and car hub in seven looks (M Style, GT, Digital '84, Sim Racing, Lumen, Pixel, Vector). Swipe between Showcase, Drive (shift lights, gear, rpm, speed, g-meter, oil and coolant), Warm-up, G-force and Tires (TPMS), with an optional Spotify panel and a home-screen widget. Optional on the car's displays: your look on the cluster dials or HUD, a cluster logo and a cluster source picker (need the Cluster renderer tool), and CarPlay's map in the cluster (needs the Waze on cluster tool; off by default). The Spotify panel needs Spotify Premium and internet through mgu-uplink. Optional encrypted crash logs are sent only if the unit has its own private drop installed.

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: the drive mode badge: statusFESVehicleDynamicSwitchHMI.actualValueModeDrivingExperience (enum ActualValueModeDrivingExperience2, by name or number); its pop-up request flags mark a change

de.bmw.infotainment.misc.MDrive._optional: the gearbox program beside the gear (DS, M3): dataDisplayGearbox.displayProgramGearbox (S / M program, by name or number; notifier only); without it the gear shows as before

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: the Tires screen: pressures, temperatures, targets, status (UInt16 raw: pressure x0.1 in the car's unit, temperature raw-40; read every 10 s; raw values logged and on the diagnostics page)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's display units (air pressure, temperature) for the TPMS values

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.navigatio._optional: the cluster logo's route guidance check: guidingState (INACTIVE / CALCULATING_ROUTE / ACTIVE; ACTIVE hides the logo); without it the logo goes by the phone's signals, and with none it stays shown

de.bmw.infotainment.a4a.carplay.CarPlayM._optional: the cluster logo's CarPlay route guidance check (Waze or Maps with a route): projectedGuidanceActive; without it the logo shows over Waze's map during a CarPlay route too

de.bmw.infotainment.sdi.aap.androidautop._optional: the cluster logo's Android Auto route guidance check: projectedGuidanceActive

config.comment: Home widget > Send a GIF (kit/runtime/gif_drop.js): widgetRelay is the public phone page (https, holds no secrets; web/widget/ on the gh-pages branch), widgetMailbox the ntfy server the phone and the car meet on (everything on it AES-256-GCM sealed; the published page talks to https://ntfy.sh only).

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget: just the G logo, large and centred (widget_logo.js from tools/make_g_icon.py: the mark alone, transparent, at 'size' and inside 'safe'). Same layout and cells as upstream's apps/edrive widget (BMW's Drive Recorder widget on this firmware): the picture goes into BackgroundImage1; every text line and the progress bar are written empty here once per placed widget. The small widget shows no pictures on this firmware (upstream's finding), so main.js sets its Title to the app's name; the big one's Title stays empty. 'safe' = share of width / height kept clear on each side (the HMI crops the edges). 0.15.0: Home widget > My GIF plays an animation in this picture instead (kit/runtime/widget_anim.js); stream: the stream widget template the Store's renderer would mount into the HMI (the stock layout without its vignette, the renderer's stream surface over its picture; not in mgu-render yet), used by kit/tools/build.py only when the renderer's marker file names it (streamWidget), else the stock layout as before (docs/animated-widget.md).
startWidget.name: G's Dash
